notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Update 1.1.0 is now out! A little late but took some time to make sure there was no more crashing when Air Units Spawned.

[b]Update 1.1.0:[/b]
- Added Map01 to Multiplayer
- Added Icons above some units ( Testing will do all other units soon once we tweak it )
- Added Dust Trails to Units
- Added Airfield for Humans Faction
- Added AirShip Fighter for Humans
- Added Anti-Air Tank for WarBorn

[b]Tweaks:[/b]
- Buildings get a increase in health
- Resources decrease from nodes ( 2500 to 1500 )
- UI (Selection / Task Managers ) Hide when not needed

[b]Fixed:[/b]
- Power Plants now give Power
- Fixed Map01 Navmesh

notes.title: Update 1.0.0
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Update 1.0.0 is now out with also a HotFix that came out for it 1.0.1 .

[b]Update 1.0.0:[/b]
- Map01 gets more detail to the map
- Air Units get removed till they are fixed
- Ground Units get animation tweaks
- Builders/Workers are now limited to gather from resources 4 at a time ( Changed from 1 to 4)
- New Shader System ( Wont see much of a changed till everything gets retextured)
- Weather System ( Wont see it but its in already just got fix main issues with the camera )
- Control Rebinding gets Removed till we redo all the Buttons Inputs
- Multiplayer gets Removed till all maps are redone and units are balanced to a point
- Removed Hover UI Health Bars
- Removed Arrow Icon above Units/Buildings
- Removed Progress UI from Buildings
- Added Minimap Icons
- Added Multithreading for FogOfWar
- Allies Removed till fixed

[b]HotFix Update 1.0.1[/b]
-Added Multiplayer (Map02 only map for Testing)
-WarBorn HeavyTank buffed (Before Unit damage 8 , Building Damage 10 , After/Now AOE Unit Damage 10 , Building Damage 20 )
-Humans Heavy Tank buffed (Before Unit Damage 8 , Building Damage 10 , Health 180 , After/Now Unit Damage 10 , Building Damage 20 , Health 200)
-ReSized Selection Box for Harvesters
-Fix Harvesters Build Speed ( was 3.5 per second , now 5 per second )
-Fix WarBorn not able to build Medics
-Fix WhiteBox UI ( Was research icon placeholder )
-Fix Audio for Units
-Fix Description UI

notes.title: Free-To-Play Update
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!,

Today the game will go Free-To-Play however the latest update i've been working on wont come out till late Wednesday between 7pm CST - 10pm CST

Reason is because my internet went off so im just on Mobile Hotspot for the moment trying to work on the game the internet wont be back on till Wednesday which is when i sending the update :)

Here's what will happen for Wednesday update.

Free-To-Play Update 1.0.0

- Map01 gets more detail to the map
- Air Units get removed till they are fixed
- Ground Units get animation tweaks
- Builders/Workers are now limited to gather from resources 4 at a time ( Changed from 1 to 4)
- New Shader System ( Wont see much of a changed till everything gets retextured)
- Weather System ( Wont see it but its in already just got fix main issues with the camera )
- Control Rebinding gets Removed till we redo all the Buttons Inputs
- Multiplayer gets Removed till all maps are redone and units are balanced to a point
- Removed Hover UI Health Bars
- Removed Arrow Icon above Units/Buildings
- Removed Progress UI from Buildings
- Added Minimap Icons
- Added Multithreading for FogOfWar

i know i will see bad reviews on the current build but please understand this update will fix some issues currently its a 1 man game till others are done with school or no longer busy and are able to help again with the game.

Please update your reviews after a few updates if you can. Anyways thank you all for your reviews and i hope you all enjoy the updates to come! ♥

notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.notes:
We are happy to Announce that update 1.1.0 is going to be a Shader / Graphic change to add more Effects for later events for maps for example ( Day / Night Cycles with Volume Fog , Snow Maps , Rain Maps , Rain Effects , Snow Effects and so on....)

By doing this we have to rebake all our current maps and including 2 upcoming maps which one of those maps is for a 3v3 testing which ill tell you here soon.
We cant say when this update will be out since we got alot of work to do.

The 3v3 Map is just the layout of the map no detail no extra life to the map basically its just the concept layout of the map it will be the first map to include the new Snow Effect. This map is being included for mainly testing and to see how we will be able to handle 3v3 maps to 5v5 maps. 

See you out there in the battlefield commanders! - RFI Leo

Update on 1.1.0 Status:

Everyone on Holiday Vaction so update wont be able to come out on the weekend due to the fact we are on holiday vaction. Everyone will return by Jan 8 2018. Ill be at home working on the Game so maybe 1.1.0 will come soon :).

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS RELEASE!
notes.notes:
[h1]Early Access Release[/h1]

Hello everyone please note that this game is very early into Early Access only buy the game if you want help support the game please dont expect a full complete game during Early Access Stages there will be alot of bugs and issues and we hope you all can help us find them!

After saying that we are happy to release our game to Early Access!

If you have issues or any crashes please go to our discord for faster support

Discord: https://discord.gg/SfGhQBW
